title: Prescriptions Patient Safety Notice: Quantity of a Strength-Error Remake
content:
The strength-error remake quantity under Kestrel Prescriptions is the number of correct-strength units dispensed at no charge on a remake that answers a confirmed wrong-strength dispensing-error report.

## The quantity

The strength-error remake quantity is the quantity dispensed on the wrong-strength fill.

- **Which report.** The remake answers the most recently reported wrong-strength report on the prescription whose review outcome is confirmed.
- **Which fill.** The fill that report names is the wrong-strength fill; its quantity dispensed is read from the fill ledger.
- **Whole units.** The strength-error remake quantity is a whole number of units, taken down to a whole number as a whole.

## Worked example (hypothetical records)

| Record | Value |
|---|---|
| Confirmed wrong-strength report, reported most recently | names fill A |
| Earlier confirmed wrong-strength report on the same prescription | names fill B |
| Quantity dispensed on fill A | 60 units |
| Quantity dispensed on fill B | 30 units |

The remake answers the report reported most recently, so the wrong-strength fill is fill A and the strength-error remake quantity is 60 units.

## Points of judgement

**A wrong-strength report on the prescription is still pending review, and an older one is confirmed.** Only a report whose review outcome is confirmed can be answered, so the older confirmed report and the fill it names decide the quantity.

**A report of a different error type was confirmed more recently.** Only wrong-strength reports are looked at for this quantity.
